shapeSummary: SPDT rocker switch with its long axis along Z: a 21.2 x 15.1 x 2.1 mm bezel flange, an 18.8 x 13 mm body below it, a boxy 16 x 9.2 x 3.5 mm rocker on top, and three 4.8 x 0.8 mm solder tabs extending down to the pin tips. Overall size is 21.2 x 15.1 x 25.9 mm, with Z running from -12.95 to +12.95.
warnings: Orientation follows boundsMm: the switch axis is Z (25.9 mm) and Y spans 0 to 15.1 mm. The Y=0 bottom is therefore a side face of the bezel, not the pin tips. Rotate the part if a Y-up orientation is wanted.
The 22.4 mm dimension is assumed to run from the bezel top to the pin tips, excluding the 3.5 mm rocker.
The body depth is assumed to be 13.2 mm measured from the bezel top, which makes the pins 9.2 mm long.
The rocker is modeled as a plain box. Its sloped top and the printed marks are omitted.
The tab pitch of 6.95 mm is derived from the printed 18.7 mm pin span and 4.8 mm tab width. The tab thickness of 0.8 mm is assumed.
The side hole on the body and the small holes in the tabs are omitted because no diameters are given.
The small latch features on the body sides are omitted.

flange = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=7.35).center(0, 7.55).rect(21.2, 15.1).extrude(2.1)
body = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-3.75).center(0, 7.55).rect(18.8, 13.0).extrude(11.1)
rocker = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=9.45).center(0, 7.55).rect(16.0, 9.2).extrude(3.5)

for x in (-6.95, 0, 6.95):
